factValues.name: gr:fact-1449e801bf178815_fv
factValues.value: In accordance with section 444 of the Companies Act 2006 (as applied by The Limited Liability Partnerships (Accounts and Audit) (Application of the Companies Act 2006) Regulations 2008) allof the members of the limited liability partnership have consented to the abridgement of the financial statements pursuant to paragraph 1A of Schedule 1 to the Small Limited Liability Partnerships (Accounts) Regulations (S.I. 2008/1912)(a).

factValues.name: gr:fact-d4a3f69cb16e8b98_fv
factValues.value: The members of the limited liability partnershiphave elected not to include a copy of the profit and loss account within the financial statements.

factValues.name: gr:fact-3bf3b29330e9f86f_fv
factValues.value: For the financial year ended 31 March 2025 the limited liability partnership was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 (as applied by the Limited Liability Partnerships (Accounts and Audit) (Application of Companies Act 2006) Regulations 2008) relating to small limited liability partnerships.

factValues.name: gr:fact-d9a21cd264bf9b0e_fv
factValues.value: The members acknowledge their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act (as applied to limited liability partnerships) with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-ae8a1b945fea1238_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to limited liability partnerships subject to the small limited liability partnerships regime.
